home.heroSubtitle: Rooms, charts, community and replays — HSN Phira+

login.title: Sign in to HSN Phira+
login.subtitle: Sign in to Phira+ with your Phira account. Your Phira email and password are submitted only to the PPB Auth Gateway for server-side verification; PPF and Panel do not receive or store your Phira password.
login.gatewayCta: Continue to the Phira auth gateway
login.gatewayHint: You will be taken to api-phira.htadiy.com to finish signing in, then returned here.
login.agreement: Account sign-in requires explicit acceptance of the currently approved Terms and Privacy versions in the authentication gateway.
login.githubCta: Use linked GitHub through the authentication gateway

terms.title: Terms & Privacy
terms.intro: Account legal acceptance and analytics/cookie consent are separate mechanisms. Public account sign-in is enabled only after the deployment configures approved Terms/Privacy versions and document URLs.

thirdParty.title: Third-party resources & data sources
thirdParty.intro: Parts of this site depend on third-party services. Please note:
thirdParty.authGateway: Phira sign-in credentials are submitted only to the PPB Auth Gateway for server-side verification; PPF and Panel do not receive or store your Phira password, and PPB does not persist the Phira password.
thirdParty.chartCdn: Chart covers and preview data may come from the Phira CDN / PPB Viewer endpoint. A clearly identified fallback artwork may be used when the resource itself is missing; network or API failures must remain an error state rather than looking like normal placeholder content.
thirdParty.externalLinks: The footer links to docs.phira.htadiy.com and the GitHub repository; external links open in a new window.
thirdParty.probes: Homepage server status and external-node latency come from PPB public endpoints; only the source and latency reported by the API are shown — IP addresses are never inferred.

analytics.title: Cookies & analytics
analytics.body: Necessary cookies (session, language, local preferences) are always enabled. Analytics are off by default and only activate after your explicit consent; we never send your credentials, JWTs, or room chat content to analytics providers, and we do not use intrusive fingerprinting.

contact.title: Contact & community
contact.body: For feedback or support, open an issue on the GitHub repository (HyperSynapseNetwork/Phira-plus-frontend) or reach us through community channels.

terms.approval: Public account sign-in is enabled only after the deployment has approved, versioned legal documents configured. This page explains data handling and third-party dependencies; the binding documents are the configured versions linked by the authentication gateway.

reauth.title: Re-authenticate Phira
reauth.body: This action requires you to re-authenticate your Phira identity.
reauth.hint: Your password is only used for this verification and is not stored.

preferences.title: Display preferences
preferences.customBackgroundHint: When you pick a custom background, the foreground and accent colors adapt automatically.
preferences.accountSyncHint: When signed in, your preferences are saved to your account and synced across devices.

consent.title: Cookies & privacy
consent.body: Necessary storage (session, language, preferences) is always enabled. Analytics only run after your consent and never collect credentials or chat content.
